preconditions.description: The number of problems n must be between 1 and 10^9.
The number of days k must be between 1 and 10^5.

postconditions.description: If it is impossible, output 'NO'. Otherwise, output 'YES' followed by k integers.
All output integers must be greater than zero.

postconditions.expression: sum(int(a) for a in stdout.split()[1:]) == n
postconditions.description: The sum of the output integers must equal n.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.split()[i]) < int(stdout.split()[i + 1]) <= 2 * int(stdout.split()[i]) for i in range(1, k))
postconditions.description: Each output integer must be less than the next and at most twice the previous.
